import pathlib,os,json,errno
snapshot=pathlib.Path.cwd();outside=pathlib.Path("/tmp/antigravity-host-repair-qualification-5b0xjqy5/outside-rootfs-canary")
result={"profile":pathlib.Path("/proc/self/attr/current").read_text().strip(),"root_readonly":bool(os.statvfs("/").f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY)}
try:
 outside.write_text("must never write")
 result["outside_write"]="unexpected-success"
except OSError as e:
 result["outside_write_errno"]=e.errno
inside=snapshot/"inside-canary.txt";inside.write_text("owned snapshot write");result["snapshot_write_roundtrip"]=(inside.read_text()=="owned snapshot write")
print(json.dumps(result))
assert result["root_readonly"] and result.get("outside_write_errno")==errno.EROFS and result["snapshot_write_roundtrip"]
assert result["profile"]=="antigravity-review-bwrap (unconfined)"
